findings.title: Existing-user magic_create tests seed nil utm, so 'does not modify' asserts nil->nil (weak but falsifiable)
findings.description: The 'confirmed user' (line 68) and 'unconfirmed user' (line 97) tests create the existing User with all utm columns nil, then POST magic_create with utm params and assert the columns stay nil. Because the seed value (nil) equals the expected value (nil), these do not strongly prove 'unchanged'. They ARE falsifiable against the specific defect they target: if the confirmed branch (registrations_controller.rb:119-145) or the unconfirmed branch (line 146-157) wrongly applied the utm params, utm_source would become 'SomeRawValue' and `to be_nil` would fail. So not a ghost test, but a stronger version would seed the existing user with non-nil utm (e.g., utm_source: 'original') and assert it is preserved, distinguishing 'preserved' from 'never set'.
findings.recommendation: Optional: seed the existing user with non-nil utm values and assert they are unchanged, to prove preservation rather than absence.

notes:
GHOST-TEST + test-correctness pass on the two NEW controller specs (both confirmed part of the feature delta 62dd55867..fc3f047f9; controller changes match: registrations sign_up_params permit + both magic_create merge branches gain the 4 utm keys; organizations#create copies the 4 keys from current_user, lines 32-35). Traced: registrations_controller.rb -> sign_up_params (l308) + magic_create (l73) ; organizations_controller.rb#create -> organization_params (l118) ; base_controller.rb (auth method names) ; recaptcha/verifier.rb (l16 short-circuit) ; db/schema.rb (utm_data jsonb on users l1287 + organizations l1091).

PER-IT FALSIFIABILITY (delete feature -> does assertion still pass?):
1. registrations magic_create 'stores four raw' (l30): FALSIFIABLE-YES. Delete utm from merge/permit -> user.utm_* nil -> `eq 'SomeRawValue'` fails. Real test. login_intent:'hire' -> `'connect'&&nil` is false -> ELSE branch (l102-114) reaches utm merge (confirms brief check #5). Recaptcha returns success in test env (verifier.rb:16) so no early-return; no stub needed. utm_data asserted string-keyed {'utm_medium'=>'email','utm_term'=>'hiring'} via fresh User.find_by -> jsonb round-trip -> string keys CORRECT.
2. registrations magic_create 'leaves nil when absent' (l50): weak negative guard (rule 13, no `|| {}`). Falsifiable only against a fabricated-fallback defect; passes if feature deleted. Legitimate, not harmful ghost.
3/4. registrations magic_create existing confirmed/unconfirmed 'does not modify' (l68/l97): weak (nil->nil) but falsifiable against an overwrite defect (params send 'SomeRawValue', asserts nil). See F1. Confirmed branch (l119) / resend branch (l146) never touch utm. sign_in works with mapping+ControllerHelpers.
5. registrations create 'persists four raw' (l127): FALSIFIABLE-YES. Delete permit -> nil -> fails. Top-level params (no user: wrapper) match sign_up_params which uses params.permit not require(:user). Real test.
6. registrations create 'leaves nil when absent' (l147): weak negative guard, same as #2.
7. organizations create 'copies four from current_user' (l40): FALSIFIABLE-YES. Delete copy l32-35 -> org.utm_* nil (organization_params does NOT permit utm) -> `eq` fails. Real test.
8. organizations create 'ignores body attribution' (l53): FALSIFIABLE-YES and CORRECTLY DISTINGUISHES SOURCE - body sends utm_source:'attacker', user has 'SomeRawValue' (DIFFERENT values). Asserts 'SomeRawValue': fails if controller read body ('attacker') AND fails if feature deleted (nil). organization_params (l119) omits utm_source so body value is dropped. This is the brief-flagged test; it is genuinely falsifiable. GOOD.
9. organizations create 'nil in all four' (l77): weak negative guard (rule 13), falsifiable only against fallback defect.

RULE CHECKS: rule30 DEVISE MAPPING - registrations spec has BOTH `include Devise::Test::ControllerHelpers` (l15) AND `@request.env['devise.mapping']=Devise.mappings[:api_v1_user]` (l24-26, in a before block that runs before dispatch/assert_is_devise_resource!). CORRECT. organizations controller is Api::V1::BaseController (NOT DeviseController) -> no mapping needed; stubs authenticate_api_v1_user!, current_user, authorize, set_sentry_context - all real method names on BaseController (l6-7, alias current_user l9, Pundit authorize). CORRECT. rule31 QUEUE ADAPTER - both specs have the around block swapping to :test (registrations l17-22, organizations l10-15); required because test.rb sets :inline and both actions perform_later PosthogIdentifyJob/PosthogTrackJob/enqueue_complete_user_setup which would fire real HTTP/Slack inline. CORRECT. rule7 STUB TYPE-MATCH - no external-API stubs exist (recaptcha short-circuits in test env), so no type mismatch. Specs exercise real actions (post :create / :magic_create), not over-stubbed. utm_data assertions all string-keyed (jsonb). No ghost tests, no dispatch-failing specs found.
